author: Ankit
problem: Given a portfolio's values over time (at least one), return the largest fall from an earlier high point to any later value, or 0 if it never falls.
bug_description: Sets the reference point to the previous value instead of the highest value so far, so it only finds the largest one-step fall.

comments.accurate: Largest fall from an earlier high to a later value
comments.wrong_behavior: Largest fall from one value to the next
comments.wrong_location: Running reference verified; check that the result never goes negative
